newsitem.title: MEXICO: Mexico peso pares losses on heavy capital inflow.
newsitem.headline: Mexico peso pares losses on heavy capital inflow.

text.p: The Mexican peso regained some ground lost in early trade against the dollar at the close on Friday, traders said.
They said a flood of foreign capital flowing into the local bourse beat back speculation in the foreign exchange market over the forthcoming end of the first half of the year, traders said.
"Dollars were in demand at 9.9750 per dollar this morning," a trader said. "Then dollars began to flow in."
The benchmark 48-hour peso and its 24-hour stablemate ended 1.7 and 2.4 centavos weaker, respectively, at 7.9600/7.9630 and 7.9570/7.9600 per dollar.
